sources.unique_value: Current Kraken Spot-EUR pair/status/minimum-order metadata; operational tradability universe truth.
sources.overlap_strategy: Primary authoritative source for live Kraken universe; no duplicate authority.

sources.unique_value: Primary event-driven Kraken Spot-EUR realtime feed for local canary/universe/shadow timing.
sources.overlap_strategy: WS is realtime primary; REST is fresh recheck/fallback/context. Redundancy is intentional, not duplicate raw storage.

sources.unique_value: Fresh Kraken ticker/OHLC rechecks and deterministic condition truth where an event wakeup requires current confirmation.
sources.overlap_strategy: Used for bounded confirmation/context, not as a second continuous raw archive.

sources.unique_value: Kraken-native public futures mark/funding/open-interest context for the same asset family.
sources.overlap_strategy: Preferred derivatives context when available; Binance is supplementary/fallback cross-market context.

sources.unique_value: Independent cross-market funding/open-interest context when it adds information unavailable from Kraken Futures.
sources.overlap_strategy: Supplementary only; never replaces Kraken-EUR execution truth. Physical MINI-PC public connectivity is proven HEALTHY on 2026-10-02; research use still requires a preregistered point-in-time trial.

sources.unique_value: Independent external alert/wakeup transport that can accelerate same-pair Kraken fresh rechecks.
sources.overlap_strategy: Redundant trigger path by design; Kraken public data remains condition truth and GitHub/Kraken-native paths remain independent.

sources.unique_value: Official macro/regulatory headline context without relying on unverified social/news summaries.
sources.overlap_strategy: Context only; not a complete news feed and not archived as a second news database.

sources.unique_value: Official Kraken historical OHLCVT provenance for point-in-time EUR replay and reproducible historical research.
sources.overlap_strategy: OHLCVT is default research source; trade-level data is only justified for questions OHLCVT cannot answer.

sources.unique_value: Trade-level timing/flow for targeted fill and microstructure questions that OHLCVT cannot answer.
sources.overlap_strategy: Full archive remains blocked by a storage-benefit gate; use only targeted questions/windows if later authorized.

sources.unique_value: Official Federal Reserve schedule and release timing for FOMC policy events used to define point-in-time macro risk windows.
sources.overlap_strategy: Calendar supplies known scheduled event timing; headline source supplies released official content. They are complementary, not duplicate raw archives.

sources.unique_value: Public no-key network metrics with heterogeneous fixed coverage and two persisted prospective known-at cycles. retrieved_at is usable as a conservative prospective known-at upper bound; AssetEODCompletionTime is not exact per-metric finality and historical backfill remains blocked.
sources.overlap_strategy: V3 H8 state/confirmation source only. Prospective-only compact capture may proceed under fixed assets/metrics with retrieved_at preserved and missingness fail-closed. Historical performance/backfill is not authorized by the two-cycle evidence.

sources.unique_value: Public Hyperliquid market/account activity context (including public-address open orders/fills) that can test whether trader activity leads later Kraken-EUR moves.
sources.overlap_strategy: Potential H10 independent trader-activity sensor only; never replaces Kraken market truth or derivatives context. Wallet selection must be separately preregistered and cannot be chosen by seen Kraken performance.

sources.unique_value: Public event/market metadata plus CLOB prices/order books can provide point-in-time probability, spread, liquidity and change context for event-risk research.
sources.overlap_strategy: H11 event-state sensor only. Official sources remain authoritative for scheduled/released facts; Polymarket measures market-implied state. Public transport plus one bounded 5-market prospective capture are green; a separated second capture is still required before state-change review, and incremental predictive value remains unproven.
